svg.aria-label: A pneumatic-tube message system on a stepped stand. At the front left, the AI lead's desk has a send console with a lever, a capsule rack and one red capsule. A riser climbs to a diverter whose shuttle picks one of three tubes; the tubes climb the steps to three offices, CFO, CIO and agency head, each one step higher. Each office has a receiver with a bin and a card holder. CFO card: Capacity is a fixed obligation. CIO card: IT rules for models. Agency head's card: Our asset or their training data. The capsule has been delivered to the CFO and its card is up.
